newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Premiere soars on speculative buying.
newsitem.headline: Premiere soars on speculative buying.

text.p: Movie outfit Premiere Entertainment Productions Inc surged 10.99 percent to 2.02 pesos in late on Friday on speculative buying, brokers said.
It hit a record high of 2.04 pesos earlier in the day. Premiere was one of the most heavily traded stocks in a generally quiet stock exchange.
"I don't know of any reason for the buying. It's probably just speculative buying," Spencer Yap, analyst at BPI Capital Corp, said.
Rolly Pineda, vice president of Regina Capital Development Corp, said the buying was not supported by fundamentals, since the local movie industry is still in the doldrums.
